traits.name: Skill Training
traits.effect: Begins with four Skills at +10 during Character Creation.

traits.name: Rank
traits.effect: Begins at Rank: Petty Officer Second Class.

traits.name: Ordnance Ready
traits.effect: May call in Spartan Ordnance for only 1 Support Point.

traits.name: Prepared
traits.effect: Begins with the Fast Foot Ability at Character Creation.

traits.name: Augmented
traits.effect: Gains all Spartan IV Augmentation Traits at Character Creation.

traits.name: Weapons Expert
traits.effect: Begins with all Faction and Weapon Training options at Character Creation.

traits.name: Carry Weight
traits.effect: Doubles Strength and Toughness when calculating Carry Weight.

traits.name: Squad Up
traits.effect: +5 Courage and +10 Warfare Melee/Range when taking Combined Actions with all UNSC Soldier Types.

insurrectionist_rules.weapon_cost_increase: Weapons without the [I] tag cost 25% more.
insurrectionist_rules.modification_discount: Weapon and Vehicle Modifications cost half cR.

mjolnir_armor.description: Spartans begin with a set of Mjolnir or SPI armor appropriate to the timeline. They may swap armor between missions.

becoming_spartan_iv.description: All Human and ORION Soldier Types may become Spartan IVs.
